◆ Result — shown last, always highlighted
How this is calculated: Points carried forward from Q1 are reduced where a partner already redeemed part of a combo trip for cash (CN); the remaining balance is the destination's total point requirement minus points carried forward and points already earned in Q2. Per the scheme circular, a partner must reach at least 65% of the total points required by 31 August, and must qualify for a higher destination in Q2 than the one earned in Q1 to unlock this upgrade.
